notes.key_messages:
Candidates should be encouraged to check that they are working to the required level of accuracy as
specified either on the front of the examination paper or within a particular question if different.
Candidates should also be encouraged to check that they have actually answered the question and not
stopped short of the final answer. Centres should check that candidates know the meaning of â€˜exact answerâ€™.
notes.general_comments:
Well prepared candidates were able to show their knowledge of the syllabus and apply appropriate
techniques to aid solution of the questions. The performance of candidates seemed to improve the farther
they progressed in the paper, often finding the later questions more accessible than the earlier ones.
